custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a vendor, vendor A.
  • Create an active part, part A, for this test, with vendor A and 0 on hand.
  • Create an open work order, work order 1, for this test, whose approved line, line 1, has two Part Requests for part A from vendor A: Part Request 1 ordered on purchase order A, and Part Request 2 not yet ordered.
  • Set part A inactive after that.
  • Start on work order 1's Parts tab.

Setup

  1. Make vendor A: Click Parts in the top bar, Vendors in the left menu, then New Vendor. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425751 VENDOR A in Name *. Click Save & Close.
  2. Make part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C425751 PART A; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425751-A; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Vendor: vendor A; Quantity (in the bin row): 0. Click Save.
  3. Make work order 1: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order. Pick any Customer and any Asset. Click Save. In the New Line window that opens, type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425751 LINE 1 in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close.
  4. Request part A on the line: In the line's Parts row click + Add Part, then More options. In the New Part Request window type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425751-A in Part Number and pick the result marked Part Library. Type 1 in Quantity. Click Save Part. Do not receive it. Order this first request; then
  5. Request part A on the line: In the line's Parts row click + Add Part, then More options. In the New Part Request window type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425751-A in Part Number and pick the result marked Part Library. Type 1 in Quantity. Click Save Part. Do not receive it. Leave the second one not ordered.
  6. Set part A inactive: On the Inventory page click Search and type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425751-A. Click its row, click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate.
